Hi Elsa — thanks for sending the W-8 and bank letter. Quick responses inline:

1) For our procurement/compliance flow we typically need either a notarized or apostilled W-8BEN-E for non-US entities so the tax team has a clean audit trail.
2) A local tax residency certificate from Agencia Tributaria is acceptable as supplemental evidence, but we still need a form that establishes foreign status for US withholding rules (that’s the W-8BEN-E).

If a local apostille and your signed CFO declaration are quicker, that will probably get the PO unblocked for our initial payment lane; compliance may ask for the notarized W-8 later for long-term vendor records.

Can you confirm whether the CFO declaration can be on company letterhead and include the following: legal name, registered address, confirmation of beneficial ownership (if different), and statement that Novafab has no US TIN? If you can upload the documents to the vendor portal and reply here with the portal link, I’ll kick off a provisional PO release with Procurement.

I’ll loop in Ben so procurement can track the conditional clearance.
